hooks.name: Check after task
hooks.description: Run fast local checks after a spec task completes and record the run in .kiro/hooks/run.log.

action.command: echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) PostTaskExec start" >> .kiro/hooks/run.log && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) PostTaskExec ok" >> .kiro/hooks/run.log
